name: Clean Cars for All - E-Bike & Transit Credit
description: $7,500 pre-paid card for e-bikes and public transit when trading in a 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle
fullDescription: For those who don't need a car, Clean Cars for All offers a mobility option with a pre-paid card for public transit and e-bike purchases, providing sustainable transportation alternatives when trading in an older vehicle.
whatTheyOffer:
- $7,500 mobility option
- Pre-paid card to use for public transit and to buy an e-bike
- Trade in a 2007 or older gas or diesel vehicle
- Supports car-free lifestyle
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in the Air District's Bay Area jurisdiction (9-county region)
2. Household income at or below 300% federal poverty level (e.g., $47,880 for 1 person, $99,000 for 4)
3. Own an operational 2007 or older gas/diesel vehicle continuously registered in California for the past 2 years
4. Register and apply online; GRID Alternatives (855-256-3656) helps with applications
5. Get approved before retiring your vehicle
6. Trade in old vehicle and receive the pre-paid mobility card
address: 375 Beale Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94105
keywords: Clean Cars for All, BAAQMD, e-bike, transit credit, car-free, trade-in, $7500, sustainable transportation
